units.source_text: 君若肯对我说一声‘可怜’，我就立刻赴死。”

en.t: If you would only say one word of pity to me, I would die at once.

units.source_text: 大女公子看了，想道：“真讨厌啊！

en.t: The elder young lady saw it and thought, “How dreadful!

units.source_text: 想必中将不曾另行抄写，就把来诗退还。”

en.t: The Captain must not have copied it out separately; he simply sent back the poem as it came.”

units.source_text: 她心中颇感不快，就此默默不语。

en.t: She felt quite displeased at heart and remained silent without saying anything more.
